description: This source file defines the 'GlyphDataTable' class within the PdfSharp library, specifically handling the parsing and management of glyph data in an OpenType font for PDF processing. It includes methods for reading glyph data, computing glyph sizes and offsets, handling composite glyphs, and preparing the font table for binary compilation.

classes.name: GlyphDataTable
classes.description: Represents the glyph data table in an OpenType font, providing methods to read and manipulate glyph data, handle composite glyphs, and serialize the table.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Placeholder method for reading glyph data; currently not implemented.

methods.name: GetGlyphData
methods.description: Retrieves the byte data for a specific glyph based on its index.

methods.name: GetGlyphSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a specific glyph's data.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Calculates the byte offset of a glyph within the font data.

methods.name: CompleteGlyphClosure
methods.description: Ensures all composite glyphs and their component glyphs are included in the glyphs dictionary.

methods.name: AddCompositeGlyphs
methods.description: Recursively adds component glyphs for a composite glyph to the glyphs dictionary.

methods.name: PrepareForCompilation
methods.description: Prepares the glyph data table for serialization by computing checksum and setting length.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the glyph data table into a binary font file.
